name: Kuga Nanase
source:
Clerk at a clothing store. Fashionable, has perfect makeup ability. She says she has no interest in anime, but...

She has a frank personality and is quite friendly.
She can easily become friends with someone she meets for the first time, and seems to have a fulfilling life every day.

She's the type to wear lightweight clothes even in slightly cold environments through sheer willpower.
